periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is oriented at a downward diagonal angle toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid morphology where the vertical dimension is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal dimension.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Clear tapering at the inferior margin, resulting in a teardrop shape extending below the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap between pinnae is roughly equivalent to the width of the individual pinna at its base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular profiles without visible flattening.
